Our customer support hours are:
Mon–Fri: ${BIZ_HOURS_MON_FRI} (WAT)
Weekends: Closed
(Timezone: ${COMPANY_TIMEZONE})

Our WhatsApp AI assistant is available 24/7. You can also reach our team via email at ${COMPANY_EMAIL} anytime.

📲 *Get the OpenSpace App:*
• *iOS (App Store):* Search 'Open Space Finance' on the Apple App Store.
• *Android (Google Play):* Search 'OpenSpace Finance' on Google Play.
• *Web Portal:* Access directly at https://app.openspace.finance

🌟 *${COMPANY_NAME}* is an AI-powered neo-fintech & lifestyle ecosystem offering:

1. 💳 *OpenPay:* Multi-wallet digital banking, instant transfers & bill payments (First 3 wallets FREE!).
2. 📈 *OpenSpace COOP Pools:* Fixed investment pools earning 15%–21% returns.
3. 🎯 *Goals (Locked Savings):* Goal-oriented locked savings earning up to 18.00% p.a.
4. 🔄 *Spend to Save & Budgeting:* Automated round-up savings & proactive spending alerts.
5. 🤝 *Ethical / Non-Interest Finance:* Sharia-compliant, interest-free Murabaha (Asset Financing) & Mudaraba (Profit Sharing).
6. 💰 *Open Credit & Loans:* Flexible personal & business loans from ₦50,000 up to ₦10,000,000.
7. 🏪 *Open Market & OpenFactoring:* Micro-lending for market traders & up to 80% invoice advance.
8. 🛡️ *OpenInsure (Coming Soon):* Simple protection plans for health, life & assets.

Which product would you like to explore?

💳 *OpenPay & Wallet Management:*
• Send and receive instant money transfers seamlessly.
• Pay bills, utility tokens, and merchant checkout.
• *Multi-Wallet Creation:* Your first *3 digital wallets are 100% FREE*! Additional wallets cost only ₦100 each to help you organize funds across different goals.

📈 *OpenSpace COOP Pools (Flexible Investment Plans):*
Earn *15% – 21% returns* with structured, professionally managed cooperative pools:

• *Basic Pool:* 90 Days (15%–21% ROI)
• *Silver Pool:* 180 Days (15%–21% ROI)
• *Gold Pool:* 270 Days (15%–21% ROI)
• *Platinum Pool:* 365 Days (15%–21% ROI)

💰 *Investment Range:* ₦100,000 – ₦10,000,000
📱 Track your investment growth in real-time on the OpenPay App!

🎯 *Goals (Locked Savings):*
• Save with purpose by locking funds toward specific milestones (Rent, Business Expansion, School Fees, Travel).
• Earn up to *18.00% interest per year* on locked funds.
• *Discipline & Security:* Funds remain locked until target maturity to help you reach your goals. (Early withdrawal before maturity incurs a fee).

⚙️ *OpenSpace Wealth Tools:*
• 🔄 *Spend to Save:* Automatically save money in the background every time you spend (e.g. Round-Up transactions to nearest ₦100 and save the spare change).
• 📊 *Automated Budgeting:* Set category limits and receive proactive notifications before you overspend.
• 📈 *Financial Analytics:* Track Total Wealth, Net Cash Flow, and daily average spending in one unified dashboard.

🌱 *Ethical / Non-Interest Finance (Built for Everyone):*
Operates completely without interest (riba), based on transparency, fairness, real asset backing, and risk-sharing. Open to all individuals regardless of background or religion:

• 📦 *OpenSpace Murabaha (Asset Financing):* We purchase business equipment/goods on your behalf; you buy them back at a transparent, pre-agreed fixed markup in flexible installments (0% interest).
• 🤝 *OpenSpace Mudaraba (Profit-Sharing):* Capital providers partner with entrepreneurs to share business profits based on pre-agreed ratios.
• 🚗 *Ijarah (Ethical Leasing):* Asset leasing structures for productive equipment (Coming Soon).

💰 *Open Credit & Loans:*
Access transparent, responsible credit with fast approvals:
• *Loan Range:* ₦50,000 – ₦10,000,000
• *Tenure:* Up to 12 months (52 weeks)
• *Requirements:* Active OpenSpace account, completed KYC, and verified transaction history.

To apply, share your desired loan amount and purpose, and our team will guide you!

🏪 *Open Market (Trader Micro-Lending & Growth):*

Open Market is tailored specifically for market women, retail merchants, and petty traders to expand their business:

• 💰 *Working Capital Loans:* Quick, accessible micro-loans from ₦20,000 up to ₦1,000,000 with flexible daily or weekly repayments matching market trade cycles.
• 📚 *Free Financial Literacy Training:* Practical coaching on business cash management, profit calculation, and reinvestment.
• 📱 *Digital Bookkeeping:* Easy-to-use mobile record management software to track stock and daily sales.
• 🚀 *No Heavy Collateral:* Designed to empower everyday market entrepreneurs.

Would you like to apply for Open Market or learn more about opening an account?

📄 *OpenFactoring (Invoice Cash Flow Financing):*

Never wait 30–90 days for client payments again. OpenFactoring unlocks your working capital instantly:

• ⚡ *Up to 80% Advance:* Receive an immediate advance of up to 80% of verified, unpaid corporate or government client invoices within 24–48 hours.
• 💼 *Smoothen Cash Flow:* Fund payroll, pay vendors, and accept new client orders without cash flow bottlenecks.
• 🤝 *Balance Payment:* The remaining invoice balance (less a small processing fee) is remitted to you once your client settles.

Would you like to speak to a specialist or apply for OpenFactoring?

🚀 *How to Create an OpenSpace Account (Takes 2–5 Mins):*

1. Download the *Open Space Finance* app or visit https://app.openspace.finance
2. Click *'Sign Up'* and enter your full name, email, and phone number.
3. Verify your email confirmation link.
4. Complete KYC verification (BVN, NIN, and valid government ID).
5. Accept the consent terms — your instant virtual account and digital wallet are ready to fund and use immediately!

⚡ *Transfer & Transaction Help:*
• *Internal Transfers:* Instant between OpenSpace users.
• *Interbank Transfers:* Usually instant, but external bank settlement networks can take up to 24 hours.
• *Troubleshooting:* Refresh your balance, check network connectivity, or pull your transaction receipt from the app.
• If you need an agent to trace a transaction, please provide your *Transaction Reference ID* and *Amount*.

⚠️ *Report a Dispute or Failed Transaction:*
I can log a formal support ticket for you right now. Please tell me:
1. Transaction Reference ID / Session ID
2. Amount debited
3. Description of what occurred

Or simply reply *'dispute'* to begin the guided step-by-step resolution flow.

🔒 *Security & Lost Phone Protocol:*
• OpenSpace uses AES-256 bank-grade encryption, 2FA, and 24/7 automated fraud monitoring.
• *Lost / Stolen Phone:* Immediately log in from another device to reset your password, or contact our support team at ${COMPANY_EMAIL} / ${COMPANY_PHONE} to temporarily freeze your account.
I will connect you with an OpenSpace customer care specialist. Please tell me briefly what you need help with, and our team will take over the chat.
